sources.note: Reverse engineering help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: Create Entity Attributes from DB adds columns not yet mapped to an existing entity, invoked from the Database or Persistence tool window or from an entity class.
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Code action 'Add attributes from database columns…' on the entity class (Alt+Enter equivalent): adds the columns of the entity's table that it does not map yet, read from a SQL DDL file of the project, or from a saved connection (read-only, confirmed first; needs process:java, not covered headlessly). Not available: the Database and Persistence tool window entries.

claims.statement: The attribute dialog separates Columns (unmapped) from Mapped Columns (already mapped to entity attributes).
claims.supports: Columns: not mapped; Mapped Columns: already mapped
claims.surfaceEquivalent: The column prompt lists only the unmapped columns; the already mapped columns (with the attribute that maps each) are shown separately in the exact preview. Not available: one dialog with both lists side by side.

undocumented: merge/conflict behaviour, type changes, removed columns
